frames.alt: a tall thin figure made of folded brass sheet
frames.caption: A tall thin figure made of folded brass sheet. Standing square to the viewer, arms held slightly away from the body. An empty tiled room with a drain in the floor. One bare bulb overhead, hard shadows. Polished brass, white ceramic tile, grey grout.
frames.anomaly: The figure has no face, only a hinge where a face would be.

frames.alt: a featureless gold metallic mannequin figure
frames.caption: A featureless gold metallic mannequin figure. Standing upright facing forward with arms outstretched to either side and palms facing up. A small enclosed room covered entirely in white square ceramic tiles on the floor and walls. White overhead light originating from a single bare bulb hanging from the ceiling. Gold metal, white ceramic tile, grey iron, and glass.
frames.anomaly: A large circular iron storm-drain grate embedded in the center of the tiled room floor.

frames.alt: a gold-colored metallic mannequin of a human figure
frames.caption: A gold-colored metallic mannequin of a human figure. It stands upright facing forward with its arms held out to the sides and palms open upward. A small enclosed room with white square tiled walls and floor beneath a flat ceiling. Bright white light emanates downward from a single ceiling-mounted light bulb fixture. Gold metal, white ceramic tile, and dark grey iron.
frames.anomaly: A large circular iron drain grate built into the center of the tiled floor.

frames.alt: a gold-colored metallic mannequin of a human figure
frames.caption: A gold-colored metallic mannequin of a human figure. Standing upright facing the back wall with its arms extended outward to the sides. A small room completely enclosed by square white ceramic tiles on the walls and floor. Soft white light cast downward from a single circular ceiling fixture. Gold-coated metal, white ceramic tile, and dark grey cast iron.
frames.anomaly: A large circular dark metal drain grate embedded in the tiled floor directly beneath the figure's feet.
